ns2:course.label: Persuasion Consumer Response
ns2:course.description: Addresses what makes a mass-mediated message persuasive by reviewing theories of mass communication and persuasion, consumer information-processing, and advertising effectiveness measures. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: ADV 281.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Advertising or Agricultural Communications major(s). Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
